subject: Side table bracket / quick question
text: Sorry this is out of order. I wanted to follow up on the side table you sold me last weekend, but I can’t find the receipt, and my notes are somewhere on the kitchen counter. The shelf bracket is missing, and I thought you said it came separately in a small plastic bag. I may have left it in the hall, or maybe the tape was stuck to the underside. I was going to mount it this evening, but the building office wants the furniture installed by Friday because they’re painting the stairwell, so now everything feels urgent. I’m not upset at all. Honestly, I probably moved the bracket while carrying the table, and then I went to get the screwdriver, lost focus, and started sorting mail instead. If the part is lost, could you tell me where I might buy a replacement that fits? The holes look like they need an eight-millimeter screw, but I’m guessing. If you have the other one, or if you remembered where it was, even a photo would help. Also, did you say you wanted me to rinse the vase before returning it, or was that for the plant stand? I have the stand in my basement, so I can pick up the bracket whenever it’s convenient. If this week is too tight, can I bring the table back and exchange it? Otherwise I’ll try the hardware store after work tomorrow. I hope I’m not making extra work for you. Sorry again for the scattered message.
